decisions.reason: As a close-to-core custom earmold with likely low carrying costs and fit with the firm's integrated hearing-care offering, it remains a worthwhile option despite its lighter website prominence.
Its dedicated launch page, strong fit with the firm's established hearing-system business, and likely made-to-order economics make continued market presence the more likely choice.

Although equipment can require more support and tie up more resources than custom parts, this thermoforming unit is close to the firm's core workflow solutions and still offers enough strategic option value to retain.
